review.summary: The plan references several modules, services, and data models that are not currently grounded in the system_state.json file. These include domainized edge function families, database RLS hardening, integration boundaries, and more. The plan should be revised to only reference existing or proposed future-state items.

findings.title: Ungrounded modules in current state
findings.evidence: The plan references domainized edge function families, database RLS hardening, integration boundaries, and other services that are not currently in the system_state.json.
findings.requiredAction: Remove or ground all unlisted modules, services, and data models before implementation.
